name: radio
description: 用于自建 Stoat 兼容实例的 iOS/Android 客户端

scripts.android:debug: pnpm --filter @radio/mobile exec expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: pnpm --filter @radio/mobile exec expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.verify: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm mobile:bundle
